recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-18519 unless a future work group decision revisits OperationOutcome.issue.location or issue.expression more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-18519 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification for FHIR-core OperationOutcome raised against STU3. It asked that wording on the OperationOutcome definitions page not imply only XML and JSON syntaxes, suggesting 'expressed in XML or JSON' be generalized to 'expressed in XML or another syntax'; the Jira resolution was Fix, and a later Jira comment says the wording had already been removed in the September release.
initial_application: No current commit explicitly mentions FHIR-18519. Git history shows the relevant OperationOutcome source was changed earlier in e8c22a3727455852300b359fe317824ad3ae2224, which deprecated OperationOutcome.issue.location and replaced the old XML/XPath-oriented local narrative with issue.expression/FHIRPath wording before the Jira comment that the September release had already addressed the problem.
additional_context: OperationOutcome is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition says issue.location is deprecated because it is XML-specific and replaced by format-independent issue.expression, while the OperationOutcome notes describe error locations as simplified FHIRPath in issue.expression. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope OperationOutcome source no longer contains the obsolete 'expressed in XML or JSON' wording and already communicates the format-independent replacement approach that satisfies the issue.
